records.name: Finite protein hydration and ionic-microenvironment source scope
openObligations: The admitted primary acquisition is8.3 mM bovine pancreatic trypsin inhibitor at pH*5.2 in isotope-enriched aqueous emulsion droplets at-10 and-30 C. pH* is uncorrected for isotope effects. This is not a physiological-temperature cellular solution or an ionic-shell experiment.

The measured quantities are longitudinal relaxation recovery/dispersion of 2H and 17O water nuclei relative to same-isotope bulk-water references. Hydration water is not separately resolved as an independent resonance because of exchange.

Lorentzian amplitudes/correlation times, water-class assignments and rotational retardation are source-model inferences. The fixed hydration number268 is estimated from existing5PTI solvent-accessible area,1.4 angstrom probe and 15 square-angstrom area per water; it is not a direct counted population.

The reported beta amplitudes are apparent Nbeta*Sbeta^2 products affected by exchange and orientational order. They are not integer water counts, unique hydration-site occupancies or directly measured residence times.

The highest-frequency point is excluded from the source mono-Lorentzian fits. A weak second component is suggested; its amplitude and the frequency-independent term have large covariance. Missing raw data and full covariance prevent an independent fit or unique distribution reconstruction.

Protein rotational times14/70 ns at-10/-30 C are viscosity/isotope/hydrodynamic-scaled adopted estimates from earlier relaxation, not new direct measurements of tumbling in these samples. Surface/internal separation depends on these and exchange assumptions.

SI S7 notes that the expected W111 internal-water behavior at-30 C is inconsistent with the observed dispersion. A local structural transformation causing much slower exchange is proposed but not measured; complete external-surface attribution remains conditional.

The source infers modest mobility retardation for most surface-contact waters, not static long-range ordering, an immobilized shell, a universal no-more-than-two bound at all temperatures, or the same timescale at every residue.

Converting rotational relaxation into residence/translational times requires additional assumptions. The source24 ps estimate at 4 C and room-temperature extrapolations are not direct primary observations at those temperatures and are not admitted as new measurements.

No ion positions, ion number/density, electrostatic potential, hydrogen-bond energy, dielectric shell, catalysis, recognition change, binding thermodynamics or protein-stability perturbation is measured by the selected acquisition.

Long-range dipolar contributions to an NOE measurement describe nonlocal magnetic sampling. They do not establish long-range structural ordering of water or ions. The paper new oxytocin and older BPTI NOE analyses are read but supply no additional admitted acquisition context or independent replication here.

The emulsion-interface control, BPTI self-association estimates, internal-water coordinates and stability/cold-denaturation arguments include earlier-work inputs. No universal absence of aggregation/interface effects or direct new folding/structure determination is inferred.

Original Level3/Phase2, Science arrays, scientific-status strings and SOMA type roles are catalogue classifications, not experimental evidence of universal arising, ontological necessity, independent reproduction or every conjunct in the original descriptions.

records.name: Protein modification and functional readout boundary
openObligations: These are engineered E. coli DHFR/cpLys38/barnase substrate constructs in rabbit reticulocyte lysate, not a universal survey of naturally damaged proteins or an intact-cell misfolding-surveillance experiment.

Proteasome attribution follows the source lysate assay. No separately purified proteasome, newly isolated E1/E2/E3 requirement, new receptor-binding measurement, ATPase-step assay, translocation movie, force measurement or proteasome-inhibitor control is supplied by the selected main panels.

SDS-PAGE/autoradiography quantifies remaining full-length plus ubiquitinated forms as defined by each panel; His6 immunoblotting localizes loss of a terminal epitope. Band loss, tail clipping, complete destruction and production/reuse of free amino acids are different outcomes.

The source tests folded and methotrexate-stabilized proteins. The assays do not establish that only misfolded proteins are degraded, that native proteins are excluded, or that the proteasome itself decides whether a client is damaged.

The engineered linear Ub4 tag has four N-to-C fused ubiquitin moieties with G76V substitutions. It is not a newly measured native Lys48-isopeptide-linked polyubiquitin chain or an independently observed covalent ubiquitination reaction.

No universal requirement for ubiquitination is admitted; the paper itself cites ubiquitin-independent cases as background. Recognition, initiation, unfolding and proteolysis remain distinct, with the detailed unfolding/pulling cycle conditional.

No raw autoradiograms, numerical rate fit, binding constant, precise substrate concentration or kinetic uncertainty is reconstructed. Exact engineered tail amino-acid sequences are not printed in the reviewed main Methods, and no universal20-residue minimum is admitted from data-not-shown observations.

The ubiquitination control adds2 micromolar Ubal to inhibit deubiquitination and 320 micromolar methotrexate to inhibit degradation. Its accumulating ubiquitin-band signal is a net assay readout under those conditions, not direct matched receptor occupancy or one isolated E1/E2/E3 rate.

Similar source ubiquitination kinetics for full versus shortened N-end-rule tags constrain reduced tagging as the explanation for the deletion effect. They do not prove equal proteasome-binding occupancy or exact chain topology.

The selected positive scope is accumulating source-assigned ubiquitinated substrate bands under blocked deubiquitination/degradation. Similar net accumulation in two linker constructs is not an isolated ligation rate, exact attachment-site map or proof of identical chain topology.

The genetically encoded linear Ub4 fusion is not a measured post-translational isopeptide-attachment event. Tagging, initiation and degradation have distinct preparations and readouts; no universal modification-to-function causal effect is isolated.

Phosphorylation, acetylation, methylation and glycosylation are not additional reviewed experiments in this scope. No universal timing after completed synthesis, fast reversibility, combinatorial signalling code or regulated network reprogramming is demonstrated.

The original cooperativity, enzyme-complex and translation parents are not measured formation events or universally necessary prerequisites of this supplied-substrate assay. The separate retinal signalling scope does not provide a matched modification pathway.

Source catalogue level, phase, role, science/status and requirement labels are representation choices. Original parent weights, necessity, directions/modes, carrier minima/critical counts and null saturation are not measured causal fractions, physical thresholds or a universal construction sequence. Generic evidence placeholders add no unidentified study or independent replication.
